data_contract.solver_parse: Read archived decimal token once as binary64; retain token text for exact witness verification

solver_options.thread_control: No undocumented thread option will be passed; record any exposed runtime/build information and make no bitwise-determinism claim
solver_options.package_classification_threshold: detectseparation control$tolerance is a different package-level decision threshold and is not supplied to HiGHS

independent_checks.positive_complete_certificate: Every exact signed margin Z_i*beta is strictly greater than zero
independent_checks.positive_weak_certificate: Every exact signed margin is nonnegative and at least one is strictly positive
independent_checks.zero_objective_rule: A zero or near-zero objective and success flag do not prove absence of a separator; compare with validated dual diagnostics and the accepted exact #6 proof
independent_checks.rank_and_conditioning: Record exact rank from accepted proof and separately report numerical singular values/condition diagnostics; do not substitute floating rank for exact rank

numeric_acceptance.margin_floor_meaning: Fixed reporting threshold at ten times the configured primal feasibility tolerance; not a mathematical class boundary and not a changed detectseparation tolerance
numeric_acceptance.coefficient_identity: Bitwise coefficient equality is not required; preserve and compare all vectors. Exact verified certificate class must be stable across repeats for a repeatability claim.
numeric_acceptance.dual_fields: Capture SciPy inequality, lower-bound and upper-bound residuals/marginals when present; missing, non-finite, or unverifiable diagnostics cannot establish a negative separation claim

typed_outcomes.meaning: A positive primal direction independently satisfies the exact required signed-margin inequalities against the archived decimal matrix
No exact positive witness was verified, or a zero/near-zero objective lacks adequate independently checked optimality evidence; this is not proof of no separation
Prespecified repeats, raw/scaled arms, algorithms, or the accepted exact proof imply incompatible results; preserve each raw result
Exception, nonzero/unknown termination, limit, malformed result, non-finite required field, or failed environment/input preflight
